response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with genuine geospatial credentials (GISCollective, Green Map, FOSS4G talk) and one strong stint building low-latency, high-throughput microservices with async I/O and fibers at Sociomantic — both relevant to a routing tiling pipeline. However, the core requirement is modern C++ (or Rust), and his only C/C++ commercial exposure is a six-month role at National Instruments over a decade ago; his last several years are TypeScript/Node full-stack and AI tooling work. There is no navigation-guidance, map-data pipeline, or large-scale distributed-systems infrastructure experience described. He could plausibly ramp up given his systems-language background in D and strong testing discipline, but he is not a direct match and would be a training bet rather than a hire-ready senior for this team.
strengths: Real geospatial/GIS product experience, including an open-source geo-data platform
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (async I/O, caching, fibers) in a systems language
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, test tooling authorship, Linux and Docker fluency
concerns: No recent or substantial modern C++ or Rust experience; last C/C++ role was ~2015 and brief
Recent 4+ years are TypeScript/Node web and AI tooling, not systems or data-pipeline engineering
No exposure to navigation guidance, routing tiles, or large-scale distributed infrastructure

key_factors.factor: Missing navigation/routing pipeline and distributed-systems background
